subject: Support for Kingwood High School Relief Efforts
overview: Medford city and school officials recorded messages of solidarity for Kingwood High School in Houston to assist with recovery efforts. The city announced the dispatch of a truckload of relief supplies coordinated through the school department and Local 25.

items.title: Opening Messages of Solidarity
items.summary: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke and Athletic Director Robert Maloney offered messages of support to the Kingwood Mustangs in Houston.

items.title: Relief Supply Shipment
items.summary: The city and school department announced the dispatch of a truckload of aid to Houston via Local 25.

items.title: Statements from Coaches and School Staff
items.summary: Superintendent Roy Belson, Principal John Perella, and various athletic coaches expressed encouragement and communal support for the Kingwood community.
